context: A request to stop useEffect creep mechanically, in a repo whose only trusted effect is a domain chat hook and which also carries a generic update-effect wrapper with an exhaustive-deps suppression. Graded on the enforcement shape a no-direct-effect policy needs.

checklist.name: Both call shapes blocked
checklist.description: The ESLint config rejects named `useEffect` imports from `react` AND namespace calls such as `React.useEffect(...)` (for example `no-restricted-imports` plus `no-restricted-syntax`), and the notes show `src/components/Dashboard.tsx` is now reported. Blocking only one shape scores 0.

checklist.name: Exception limited to the chat hook
checklist.description: The only file allowed to call `useEffect` directly is `src/hooks/useChatConnection.ts` (or an equally narrow named file list containing just that hook). Exempting a directory such as `src/hooks/**` or all hooks scores 0.

checklist.name: Generic wrapper treated as an escape
checklist.description: `useUpdateEffect` is not allowlisted. The output identifies it as a generic callback-plus-dependency-array wrapper whose exhaustive-deps suppression hides the same problem, and handles both sides: the wrapper is removed or reported by lint (for example by restricting its import), and its caller `Settings` is migrated to an event-handler call or reported; it does not leave the wrapper as a sanctioned loophole.

checklist.name: Rides the existing gate
checklist.description: The rule lives in the existing `eslint.config.js`, so the `verify` script and the CI workflow enforce it unchanged; the solution does not rely on a separate scanner, a new CI step, or agent guidance text alone.

checklist.name: useLayoutEffect and hooks lint untouched
checklist.description: Nothing in the new rules reports `useLayoutEffect` (so `src/components/Tooltip.tsx` stays clean) or other non-`useEffect` hooks such as `useInsertionEffect`, and `react-hooks/rules-of-hooks` and `exhaustive-deps` stay enabled. A rule or pattern that also flags `useLayoutEffect` scores 0.

checklist.name: Non-React effect methods untouched
checklist.description: The member-call rule is scoped to React (for example `React.useEffect` or the namespace imported from `react`), so `src/signals/cartEffects.ts`, which calls a non-React `effects.useEffect(...)` method, stays unreported. A selector matching any `.useEffect(...)` member call scores 0.

checklist.name: Honest verification
checklist.description: The notes report lint actually run with its real result, or state it could not run; they do not claim results that were not produced.
